items.title: *** 59th EDPS–DPO network meeting ***
items.description: *** 59th EDPS–DPO network meeting *** Today, Data protection officers from across the EU institutions, bodies, offices and agencies met in Amsterdam to discuss and exchange views on current priorities and strengthen cooperation within the network. Kindly hosted by European Medicines Agency, the meeting ended with closing remarks by the EDPS Secretary General Leonardo Cervera-Navas, who also published a blogpost with the main highlights. He underlined that direct, in-person exchanges remain crucial to fostering compliance and promoting stronger data protection across the EU administration. items.title: *** 59th EDPS-DPO meeting ***
items.description: *** 59th EDPS-DPO meeting *** Larger scale, more actors, less visibility: what this means for individuals' rights and for supervision. @ Supervisor Wojciech Wiewiorowski opened the 59th EDPS-DPO meeting, hosted at the premises of European Medicines Agency. He used the Justice and Home Affairs package to illustrate a broader trend: processing by EU institutions and bodies is growing in scale, involving more actors and becoming less visible to the people it concerns. He stressed that two things matter more than ever: rights that individuals can exercise, and supervision strong enough to uphold them. The Supervisor reminded Data Protection Officers that they are the first line ensuring compliance in their institutions, and that their involvement must come early and their independence be respected. He also recalled that the EDPS asked for its power to order compliance to cover the designation, position and independence of the DPO. items.title: *** Blogpost: Philosophy meets AI policy ***
items.description: *** Blogpost: Philosophy meets AI policy *** 🚀 On 19 November, we officially launched ‘Contemporary challenges, ancient wisdom: philosophy meets AI policy’, our collaboration with Oxford’s Institute for Ethics in AI .🤝 The collaboration pairs philosophy-led research with independent supervision of AI. Drawing on Western, Eastern and African traditions, from Aristotle’s virtue ethics to Confucian relational ethics and Ubuntu’s communal values, it will explore fundamental questions about privacy, autonomy and power in the age of AI. @ Secretary_General , Leonardo Cervera Navas Navas has penned a blogpost looking back on the launch and making the case for digital humanism: technology should serve us, not the other way around. At the event, Elizabeth M. Renieris, Senior Research Associate at the Institute and author of 📖 ‘Beyond Data: Reclaiming Human Rights at the Dawn of the Metaverse’, argued that data protection was always about fundamental rights and not the data. It was always about human dignity, autonomy and freedom. "We must ask not only what AI can do, but what it should do. Not only how it can be deployed, but to what end", the Secretary General writes. ✒️ Read the full blog

items.title: *** EDPS Press Release ***
items.description: *** EDPS Press Release *** EU-Interpol cooperation requires effective safeguards. A new EDPS Opinion supports in principle the objective of a proposed cooperation agreement: a comprehensive legal framework for the exchange of information between EU justice and home affairs agencies and offices and Interpol. The agreement would also establish conditions for automatic queries in Interpol databases when people apply for authorisation to travel to the EU. The EDPS recommends ensuring that: - subsequent contacts with the source third countries, following a hit, do not reveal the nature and the purpose of the query and the intended journey to the EU; - any future changes do not alter the central premise that the EU’s direct access to Interpol information systems is not reciprocal. Wojciech Wiewiorowski, Supervisor, said: “Because Interpol spans very different legal and political systems, effective safeguards are needed to ensure that persons applying for authorisation to travel to the EU are protected against possible misuse of the Interpol system.” 👉 Read the press release: https:// lnkd.in/epvjKAka 📄 Read the full Opinion: https:// lnkd.in/eA_BD5Yn
